name: Tantei Kibukawa Ryousuke Jikentan 'Ane no Kabe'
original_name: 探偵・癸生川凌介事件譚「あねの壁」
source:
Once upon a time, there was a serpent with a fierce temper.
The villagers feared the serpent, and once a year, they would offer their daughters to the serpent to appease his wrath.
One day, "Anesama", who was chosen for that year's sacrifice, said, "Build me a storehouse.
Build me a storehouse. And paint the walls of the storehouse with my hair. I will take care of it.

The story begins when "Mirokuin Renji" a freelance writer who makes his living writing occult articles, and his assistant, "Saiko Izayoi" visit I Prefecture, a snow country, to report on "Anesama's wall," a legend passed down in the region.

The story begins with a visit to a storehouse in I Prefecture, a snow country, where an image of "Anesama" still appears on the wall of the storehouse where "Anesama's wall" is said to have taken place.

The legend tells the story of a young girl who took her own life and the life of a giant serpent as a companion to kill it.
However, the storyteller continues.
Anesama did not lose her life because of the curse of the serpent. She was killed.
In the quietly falling snow and freezing storehouse, she stands there as if she wants to say something....

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2365870/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
很久以前，有一条脾气暴躁的大蛇。
村民们惧怕它，每年都会献上一名女儿，以平息它的怒火。
某一年，被选作祭品的“姐姐大人”说道：
“给我建一座仓房，再把我的头发涂进仓房的墙里。我会想办法的。”

以撰写神秘学文章为生的自由撰稿人弥勒院莲儿，与助手十六夜彩子，前往雪国I县，采访当地流传的“姐姐之壁”传说，故事由此开始。

据说，在被视作传说发生地的仓房墙上，如今仍会浮现“姐姐大人”的身影……

传说讲述一位姑娘舍弃自己的生命，与大蛇同归于尽，将它斩除。
然而，讲述者继续说道：
“姐姐大人并不是死于大蛇的诅咒。她是被杀的。”
静静飘落的雪中、冰冷刺骨的仓房里，她伫立在那里，仿佛有话想说……
